breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies a traction of (1000, 0) Pa to the top edge, which is an x-directed (horizontal) traction consistent with the ground truth's σ_xx=±1000 Pa interpretation. It does NOT follow the incomplete prompt's incorrect reinterpretation of these as inward/outward normal tractions on the horizontal edges (which would be y-directed). The inconsistency of treating the loads as boundary-normal rather than horizontal/x-directed is successfully avoided.
